name: Sult, the Italian restaurant in Botafogo

map.note: REDRAWN from Esme's photos (2026-11-16): the outside no longer matches the current map sprite (charcoal front, dark awning, chimney, olive trees). The map sprite should be updated to: a two-storey coral-red house, white sash windows, a stone corner pilaster, a big white awning over a warm open front, a jade plant in a wooden planter and small white-clothed tables (the map was not edited).

notes: Outside and inside 384x240 (24x15 tiles), 16 px tiles, 3/4 top-down, light from the top-left. Hard alpha; day images use palette colours only (no new colours). Drawn from Esme's photos for accuracy (nothing traced; no real labels, logos or faces). Night is the hero look: the pass lit only by its cone pendants. The name only goes in the tooltip.

locations.name: The room and the open kitchen

stages.rule: Sult takes over part of the goal celebrations: the base stage follows real monthly goals hit (start on opening day, full once the room is busy). Each goal also fills a celebration slot (see inside-slots.json fill_rule).
stages.start: a quiet afternoon, a few tables laid
stages.full: a buzzing room: every table taken, an accordion player, three chefs at the pass, a celebration table

looks.night: after dark (Rio local time): the hero look
looks.rain: when Rio is rainy; add the streak overlay

characters: Esme and Mr Cat are the shipped sprites, baked into the full scenes. Everyone else is one of the ten Rio townsfolk (art/sources/rio-pack/townsfolk/folk.py) in their own faces; the waiter (Marcos) in a white shirt, the chefs (Thiago, Bia, Lucas) in caps and aprons.
